//subagent-qa: subagent-qa: SubagentStop QA scan + error-mode TELEMETRY (O-series 2026-08-04; hook now at build qa3-20260806 writing schema 2, 2026-08-06 — this description tracks THAT build). Registers on SubagentStop, which MEASURED 2026-08-04 was registered: False — nothing fired when a child finished, so every child's output was judged by whatever attention the coordinator had left at collect. Hook = subagent_qa_gate.sh: (1) resolves WHOSE TEXT to scan, because MEASURED 2026-08-06 over 1108 accumulated rows `transcript_path` is ALWAYS the PARENT session transcript, whose last assistant message is usually the COORDINATOR's rather than the finishing child's. The ladder, in order: payload-direct (the payload's own last_assistant_message — the child's final text handed over by the harness, so no transcript is parsed for the scan at all) → the exactly-attributed child transcript (named in the payload, matched by SHAPE not by key name, else derived from agent_id) → the trailing isSidechain run → a last-resort sibling-by-recency, REFUSED outright when the payload named an agent_id whose own file is absent (every sibling would then be another child) → the whole file. The row's `scan_scope` says which rung answered. (2) identifies the child — the resolved child's own agent-<id>.meta.json `agentType`, else a payload agent_type, else the parent transcript's last Task subagent_type, else 'unknown' — recording which key answered in `agent_type_source`; an unknown identity gets the LIGHT pass only, i.e. it under-scans rather than over-blocks. (3) scans that text: LIGHT pattern set for every child, the FULL set plus the three supervised-executor classes (scope-drift / thrash / timidity) for a pinned executor. (4) APPENDS ONE ROW PER COMPLETION to $CRT_ERROR_MODE_LOG (default ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/dev/error_mode_log.jsonl), CLEAN COMPLETIONS INCLUDED because a rate needs a denominator — carrying `build` (so pre-fix and post-fix rates are never pooled), `agent_id` beside `child_id` (a divergence between them is a VISIBLE mis-attribution rather than a silent one), and `model` with `model_source`, where the child's own SERVING STAMP outranks every recorded launch argument; an identical row inside a 2s window is one completion arriving twice, so it is skipped and the skip is logged. (5) emits ONE advisory nudge — {"decision":"block","reason":...}, the only channel a Stop-class hook has — when a finding reaches severity 2 AND the scanned text is provably the child's own; on an unverifiable scope the row is still written and the nudge stands down. stop_hook_active guards it, so it can never loop. The findings are regex CANDIDATES, not verdicts. FAIL-OPEN ALWAYS, and the log write is best-effort with errors swallowed to a <log>.err sidecar: telemetry must never break a session. CRT master switch: 'off' = fully inert (no scan, no row); 'observe' = scan and LOG but never nudge (that is the arm for measuring unaided behaviour, so telemetry keeps running); 'on' (default) = scan, log, nudge. Reader: dev/tools/error_mode_rates.py (accepts schema 1 AND 2 — the log is append-only history, never rewritten to a new schema). Regression guard: tests/test_subagent_qa_gate.sh. Keep the command string byte-identical across any future touch (merge dedups by command).
